title: Research sprint goal: An optional OpenTelemetry adapter exports kbmon's metrics, events and spans and serves /metrics on loopback
goal: Answer with the kb tools first and the live docs for the gaps, written as kb facts and gap entries through /kb-research, extending claude/otel-monitoring and logs/otel-collector-otlp-pipeline or a new OpenTelemetry Python SDK article: (1) Which OpenTelemetry Python packages and versions provide the SDK, the OTLP/HTTP exporters and the Prometheus metric reader? (2) Does the Python OTLP/HTTP exporter send protobuf or JSON bodies, and which Content-Type does it set? (3) How does the Python SDK read OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT, OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_HEADERS and the per-signal variables, and how is a headers value written? (4) How does an observable gauge callback report values in the Python SDK, and when does PeriodicExportingMetricReader call it? (5) How does the Python Prometheus metric reader serve /metrics, and on which address does it listen? (6) How does an OTLP/HTTP server signal partial success, and which status codes may a client retry? (7) How does a Python span take explicit start and end times and a parent from another span? (8) How does the Python SDK emit an OTLP log record with an event name and attributes?

gates.question: Where do the OpenTelemetry Python SDK facts go: a new article logs/otel-python-sdk, or extra facts in claude/otel-monitoring and logs/otel-collector-otlp-pipeline?
Which source states the Python SDK behaviour in the article: the source at the v1.45.1 tag (CODE facts) or the opentelemetry-python documentation site (DOC facts)?
options: source at the v1.45.1 tag, with the OTLP specification for the protocol rules
gates.recommendation: source at the v1.45.1 tag, with the OTLP specification for the protocol rules
